A1.justification: Both PDFs describe E-RayZer and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. The material supports reliable comparison, including matching renamed supplementary figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original pose estimation, novel-view synthesis, depth and flow transfer experiments, curriculum ablations, and supplementary analyses in Tables 1–9.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the supplementary pose-supervision, pre-training, and training-data analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3.3 revises the stated curriculum sampling rule from t=(V-1)Δt_u(s) to t=(K_ref-1)Δt_u(s), using the reference-view count rather than the total input-view count. This is a localized procedural revision; the architecture, losses, and rendering pipeline are retained.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation datasets and tasks are retained, including the seven-dataset mixture, supplementary SpatialVID experiment, and pose, synthesis, depth, and flow tasks. Dynamic scenes are discussed as future work, not newly evaluated.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain SPFSplat, RayZer, VGGT*, the representation-learning baselines, and the supplementary pose-supervised baseline. Newly cited DBARF is discussed only as related work.

E3.justification: The revised temporal-span formula in Section 3.3 changes the reported training-sampling prescription. The ten input views, five-reference/five-target split, training budgets, metrics, and test sequence lengths remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 removes the tractor-scene PCA feature comparison in v1 Figure 5 and its accompanying analysis. Other feature comparisons remain in the appendix, with v1 Figure 6 becoming v2 Figure 5. Curriculum, data-scaling, and pose-supervision analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and rankings in Tables 1–9 are unchanged. A limited qualitative result is removed: the tractor-scene feature visualization in v1 Figure 5. The other visual results are retained.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 changes the mathematical definition of the sampled sequence span from dependence on V to K_ref. These denote different view counts, so this is not equivalent notation. Other equations are retained apart from notation changes; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract footnote, introduction, and Figure 1 caption explicitly qualify the VGGT comparison as the authors' reproduction with matched architecture and training settings. This narrows the headline claim to VGGT*, already identified in v1's experimental setup. The principal contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The new Discussion explicitly identifies static-scene restrictions, limited high-quality static data, and the curriculum's dependence on continuous frames with fairly uniform camera motion. It notes possible difficulties with sparse images or abrupt viewpoint changes. Section 4.3.2 also clarifies that single-view backbones perform monocular depth estimation.

D1.justification: Appendix A newly reports approximately 198 hours of training on the already specified eight A100 GPUs and clarifies that cosine learning-rate decay ends at zero. Section 4.3.2 clarifies the single-view depth baseline setup. These are additional disclosures, not established changes to those experiments.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds DBARF and NeRF, distinguishing DBARF's multistage synthesis pipeline from E-RayZer's framework and downstream representation evaluation. It also adds SimCLR and Context Encoders citations and refines the representation-learning taxonomy.

P1.justification: v2 polishes wording across the abstract, introduction, related work, methods, and results. The Conclusion becomes a Discussion with limitations, and acknowledgements expand. The overall narrative and section sequence remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v1 Figure 5 is removed, while supplementary Figures 6 and 7 become Figures 5 and 6 without replacement content. Captions and page layout receive limited adjustments, including fitting the Discussion onto page 8. Table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 more accurately qualifies the headline VGGT comparison, states meaningful applicability limits, and improves training documentation and related-work context. These gains outweigh the loss of one qualitative feature example because other examples and all quantitative tables remain. The unexplained sampling-formula revision does not establish improved experimental performance.
